headline: Critical PHP Flaw Triggers Global Patching Rush and Hacking Spike
summary: A critical security flaw in the PHP programming language has prompted a global rush to patch vulnerable systems. A cloud firm reports millions of hacking attempts have followed the disclosure affecting web software.
why: PHP underpins a vast majority of global business and government websites, making widespread vulnerabilities a severe systemic risk for cybersecurity infrastructure.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity
impacts.why: Widespread server vulnerabilities drive increased corporate spending on security patching and defense software.
